name: payum/core
description: One million downloads of Payum already! Payum offers everything you need to work with payments. Friendly for all PHP frameworks (Symfony, Laravel, Laminas, Yii, Silex). Check more visiting site.

suggest.payum/paypal-express-checkout-nvp: self.version If you want to use paypal express checkout, digital goods or recurring payments
suggest.payum/paypal-pro-checkout-nvp: self.version If you want to use paypal pro checkout
suggest.payum/paypal-rest: self.version If you want to use paypal rest gateway
suggest.payum/paypal-ipn: self.version If you want to use paypal instant payment notifications(Paypal IPN)
suggest.payum/authorize-net-aim: self.version If you want to use Authorize.Net AIM payment gateway
suggest.payum/be2bill: self.version If you want to use be2bill payment gateway
suggest.payum/payex: self.version If you want to use payex payment gateway
suggest.payum/omnipay-v3-bridge: ^1 If you want to use omnipay's gateways
suggest.doctrine/orm: ^2.14 || ^3.0 If you want to store models to database using doctrin2 ORM
suggest.doctrine/migrations: ^3.6 If you want to move stored token details from serialized PHP to JSON
suggest.doctrine/mongodb-odm: ~2.0 If you want to store models to mongo doctrin2 ODM
suggest.laminas/laminas-db: ~2.0 If you want to store models to Laminas Db ORM
suggest.symfony/routing: ^6.4 || ^7.0 || ^8.0 If you want to use TokenFactory from symfony's bridge
suggest.symfony/http-kernel: ^6.4 || ^7.0 || ^8.0 If you want to use HttpRequestVerifier from symfony's bridge
suggest.symfony/http-foundation: ^6.4 || ^7.0 || ^8.0 If you want to use HttpRequestVerifier or HttpResponse reply from symfony's bridge
suggest.symfony/form: ^6.4 || ^7.0 || ^8.0 If you want to use forms
suggest.symfony/dependency-injection: ^6.4 || ^7.0 || ^8.0 If you want to use container aware stuff
suggest.monolog/monolog: ~1.0 If you want to use PSR-3 logger
suggest.defuse/php-encryption: ^2 If you want to encrypt gateways credentials in database
suggest.symfony/lock: ^6.4 || ^7.0 || ^8.0 Required by LockingMiddleware to stop two requests processing the same payment at once
suggest.psr/cache: ^1.0 || ^2.0 || ^3.0 Required by CacheIdempotencyStore to keep idempotency records in a PSR-6 cache
suggest.doctrine/dbal: ^3.0 || ^4.0 Required by DbalIdempotencyStore to keep idempotency records in a database table
